page_title: NIC 3-1 AUX | Nice v Auxerre 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Terem Moffi (Nice) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the crossbar.
90+1' Substitution. Tom Louchet did his best and is replaced by Hamza Koutoune (Nice).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Sofiane Diop (Nice) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

89' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Pablo Rosario (Nice) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Theo De Percin was alert and made a comfortable save.
86' Yehvann Diouf leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Kevin Danois (Auxerre).
84' Sofiane Diop (Nice) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
82' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break. The possession of the ball – 51:49.
78' Referee Jeremy Stinat points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Terem Moffi (Nice) goes wild in celebration.
77' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Nice players aren’t happy.

76' 3 - 1 Goal! Tom Louchet hands Terem Moffi (Nice) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the middle of the goal. 3:1.
76' Pablo Rosario (Nice) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Theo De Percin was alert and made a comfortable save.
75' Rough tackle by Danny Namaso (Auxerre). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Here is a change. Marvin Senaya is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Lamine Sy (Auxerre).
73' The substitution has been made. Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) has replaced Lassine Sinayoko.
73' A substitution has been made. Gideon Mensah is replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
73' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Jeremie Boga is replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
73' Substitution. Kevin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Terem Moffi (Nice).
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
70' Tom Louchet (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
67' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
66' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
63' Here comes a substitution. Sofiane Diop (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Isak Jansson.
63' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Salis Abdul Samed and he is replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
62' Substitution. Danny Namaso (Auxerre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ibrahim Osman walks off.
61' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Kojo Peprah (Nice) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

60' That was close by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
59' The shot by Isak Jansson (Nice) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Theo De Percin.
58' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
56' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' CHANCE! Kevin (Nice) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
53' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Auxerre are ruled offside.
52' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' Jeremie Boga (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+9' Jeremy Stinat has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Kevin (Nice) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45+6' Melvin Bard (Nice) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Theo De Percin.
45+5' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Theo De Percin (Auxerre) replacing Gabriel Osho.
45+1' Donovan Leon (Auxerre) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. One of the players from Auxerre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Nice get a free kick.
44' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
43' Jeremie Boga (Nice) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

42' Good clearance! Kevin (Nice) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.
41' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
40' Dangerous play by Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre). Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
36' The ball is crossed into the box and Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf gets a glove on it to thwart him.
34' Jeremy Stinat has issued a yellow card to Isak Jansson (Nice).
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:6. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:4.
31' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Melvin Bard (Nice) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
27' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' 2 - 1 What bad luck! Clement Akpa (Auxerre) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 2:1.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Ibrahim Osman plays a pass to the feet of Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Auxerre.

18' Ooh that was close! Isak Jansson (Nice) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
17' There's an opportunity for Jeremie Boga (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
15' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. One of the players from Nice won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

13' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
12' Auxerre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' Jeremy Stinat couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) and blew his whistle.
7' Auxerre control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' A player from Auxerre commits a rough challenge. Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
3' 1 - 0 Jeremie Boga (Nice) meets a perfect cross from Tom Louchet deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:0.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Nice will take the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
